_comment: Environment assets the prologue script names, by scene.
Village props already covered by greenvale_props.json are not repeated.
The Crownwall is the important one. It appears on the horizon in every
Greenvale scene and the script says it should 'almost look impossible, too
large to have been built by humans'. That is a lighting, fog and scale
problem, not a polygon problem: it is budgeted as a set_piece because the
player never gets close to anything except the breached section.

assets.subject: colossal ancient wall section of dark fitted stone blocks with vast iron bands and buttresses, featureless and seamless, no gates or windows
assets.extra: modular horizontal tile, flush ends so the wall repeats to the horizon
assets.notes: Tiles horizontally to fill the skyline. Must read as inhuman: no human-scale detail anywhere on it, because a door or a window would give the eye a scale reference and destroy the effect. Scale is set in map data, not by the class default.

assets.subject: cracked and buckled section of colossal ancient wall, one iron plate split inward, rubble spilling through a narrow gap
assets.extra: damage reads from the inside face, gap wide enough for a person
assets.notes: Scene 07 through 08. Needs two states: cracked (people audible behind it) and collapsed (the turn-3 battle event opens a passable gap). Generate the cracked version and author the collapsed variant from it so the silhouettes match.

assets.subject: collapsed section of colossal ancient wall, one iron plate torn fully inward, a wide passable gap and a spill of massive rubble blocks
assets.extra: gap wide enough for a cart, silhouette matches the cracked version
assets.notes: Swapped in by the turn-3 event in battle_the_breach. Must share the cracked version's overall silhouette and palette or the swap will read as a pop rather than a collapse. Generate after the cracked version and use it as the visual reference.

assets.subject: squat round stone watchtower with a broken timber door, a battered conical roof and narrow slit windows
assets.extra: stands directly against the Crownwall, so its top must sit far below the wall line
assets.notes: Scene 07. The height relationship with the Crownwall is the whole point of the composition.

assets.subject: modest stone keep with two square towers and green pennants, low curtain wall
assets.extra: silhouette only, read at distance across the village rooftops
assets.notes: Scene 02 skyline. Deliberately modest: it has to look small against the Crownwall.

assets.subject: overturned two-wheeled wooden merchant cart with a broken axle, spilled crates and scattered cloth bundles
assets.extra: reads as violence from above, one wheel still raised
assets.notes: Centrepiece of the battle 01 battlefield and the scene 06 investigation. The absence of a body is the story beat, so the spill pattern should look interrupted rather than looted.

assets.subject: small abandoned timber guard post with a lean-to roof, a toppled brazier and an empty weapon rack
assets.extra: abandoned in a hurry, nothing tidy
assets.notes: Gameplay 03. Sits beside the broken sword and the blood with no body.

assets.subject: snapped iron sword blade, jagged break two thirds up, plain leather grip
assets.extra: lies flat, readable as broken from directly above
assets.notes: Story interactable: 'the blade is still warm'.

assets.subject: upright timber weapon rack holding practice swords and spears
assets.notes: Training yard. Rowan collects his Iron Sword here in the equipment tutorial.

assets.subject: straw and sackcloth training dummy on a timber post with rope bindings and old cuts
low round stone village fountain with a simple central spout and a mossy basin
plump village chicken with folded wings and a red comb
assets.extra: very small, chunky simplified bird shape
assets.notes: Scene 02 names chickens crossing the road. Static prop for now; if they need to wander, promote to a rigged asset with a walk clip.

assets.subject: small stone village house with a timber-framed upper storey and a steep thatched roof
assets.extra: modular kit piece, flush walls and grid-aligned footprint

assets.subject: small stone village house with a single storey, a lean-to porch and a slate roof
assets.extra: modular kit piece, flush walls and grid-aligned footprint

assets.subject: two-storey village house with an overhanging upper floor, shuttered windows and a thatched roof
assets.extra: modular kit piece, flush walls and grid-aligned footprint

assets.subject: open-fronted village smithy with a stone chimney, a brick forge, an anvil and a timber awning
assets.extra: open front so the interior reads from the street

assets.subject: two-storey village inn with a wide timber door, a hanging sign bracket and a thatched roof
assets.extra: modular kit piece, widest building footprint in the village

assets.subject: low dry-stone village wall section, one module wide, flush ends for tiling
assets.extra: modular kit piece aligned to a one metre grid

assets.subject: timber and stone village gate with an open double door and a short palisade to either side
assets.notes: Gameplay 02. Where the gate guard delivers the watchtower warning.

assets.subject: large flat-topped granite outcrop with angular faces, wide enough to sit on
assets.notes: Scene 10 forest overlook. Maeve sits on this during the closing conversation, so the top face has to be flat and at a plausible height.
